title: Streamline Your Biotech R&D with Scispot: The Power of Connection and Visualization
summary: Scispot enables seamless connection between all of your databases, making biotech R&D as simple and accessible as possible for all startups and scaleups.
body_markdown:
Biotech startups generate an incredible amount of R&D data each and every day. From equipment and inventory management to sample tracking and data analysis, there are countless databases that must be managed, monitored, and connected to ensure that startups have the insights they need to advance their work. That's where Scispot comes in.


‍


### A connected solution for biotech R&D


At Scispot, we are focused on making biotech R&D as simple and accessible as possible for all startups and scaleups. One of the key ways we do this is by enabling seamless connection between all of your databases. With Scispot, you can easily connect your equipment and inventory management systems, sample tracking databases, and data analysis Labsheets (advanced LIMS), all within a single, user-friendly, regulatory-compliant interface. For example, a startup could connect their patient database with their biospecimen inventory (samples collected from patients), then again to a DNA library (if they are isolating DNA from biospecimens), and to associated primer libraries, RNA libraries, or protein libraries, and to PCR and other data analysis Labsheets.


‍


### Visualizing biotech R&D data


But it's not just about connection. At Scispot, we also believe in the power of visualization. After all, the sheer amount of R&D data generated by[biotech startups](https://www.scispot.com/blog/revolutionizing-biotechnology-exploring-10-innovative-venture-backed-companies) can be overwhelming, and it's often difficult to make sense of all of it without the right tools. That's why Scispot makes visualization quick and easy.


With Scispot, you can create custom charts, graphs, and other visualizations to help you better understand your data. Whether you need to generate a pie chart showing the breakdown of equipment usage across your lab, or a line graph illustrating changes in sample concentration over time, or a scatter plot for your pharmacokinetic analysis, Scispot makes it easy.


‍


‍


And it's not just about creating static visualizations, either. With Scispot, you can generate dynamic visualizations that update in real-time as new data is added to your databases. This means that you can easily monitor changes and track trends, all within a single platform.


‍


‍


But the benefits of Scispot don't stop there. Our platform also offers templates for experiments, data analysis, and regulatory compliance, all designed to make biotech R&D as streamlined and efficient as possible. With Scispot, you can connect, and visualize your data, make your workflows repeatable, and scale your[biotech startup](https://www.scispot.com/blog/top-10-emerging-biotech-companies-in-india) with ease.
